objective: Bind the public starter to one local project and create its first evidence-backed checkpoint without importing private material.
excluded_scope: No automatic model or connector activation
acceptance_criteria: Local project identity and scope are explicit
Initial checkpoint records evidence, uncertainty and next action
Deterministic tests pass in the local environment
verification_route: Schema validation, scoped unit tests and human review of local scope.
resume_action: If interrupted, retain the local packet and continue from the first unmet acceptance criterion.
